title: Effective Jacobi equidistribution at CONSTANT index is the Rojas-Leon homothety lever read backwards: the prize's large automorphism is the multiplicative h-shift, giving sqrt(q) per-h but only m statistics
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley. After the (genuine, in-tree) reduction B -> tangent sums via A_h=m*conj(tau_h)*T_h with |tau_h|=sqrt(q) flat (Weil), the open object is the m-average T(phi)=(1/m)sum_i J(chi^i,phi). Welds back to the 25-year-open thin-subgroup sqrt-cancellation (BGK / generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue).
